capabilityGenome.whatNormalizationIs: A typed description of an untrusted public document. src/capability-genome-body-normalize.mjs maps prose onto atoms only through the reviewed table in artifacts/capability-genome/atom-evidence-terms.json, takes sideEffectClass from the taxonomy rather than the body, recognises only explicit SPDX licence identifiers, and walks DISCOVERED -> NORMALIZED through transitionCapability so the state has a real history entry.
capabilityGenome.whatTheTwoRecordsActuallySay: anthropics/skills brand-guidelines matched NO atom in the 25-atom taxonomy and normalized with zero atoms, which is a result rather than a failure. vercel-labs/skills find-skills claims exactly one atom, capability.discover, and screens REVIEW for remote-package-execution and unconfirmed-global-install. Both carry license UNKNOWN.
capabilityGenome.securityScreening: Normalization emits STATIC evidence and nothing else. admitCapability requires STATIC, SEMANTIC and SANDBOX, so one regex pass cannot make anything eligible. Screening is bound to the exact content hash it ran against; a quarantined body is still recorded rather than hidden.
capabilityGenome.scannerRepair: The instruction scanner matched `.sh` anywhere in a URL, so a body was flagged HIGH for citing skills.sh while `npx skills add -g -y` -- remote package execution plus a global install with confirmation suppressed -- tripped nothing. The URL rule now requires the extension after the host (path, query or fragment), and two new codes catch the real act. find-skills is still REVIEW, now for the true reason.
capabilityGenome.notClaimed: Two normalized records is two typed descriptions. Nothing is deduped, security-reviewed, eligible, approved, active, installed, benchmarked or economically proven. A skill body is not a capability; NORMALIZED is not APPROVED; STATIC_CLEAR is not SAFE.

modelFailoverTruth.hazardFound: runAgentWorkerOnce submits terminal failures itself, so a naive chain that failed then succeeded would report both outcomes for one task. Fixed and pinned by ROUTE-06.
decisionsRecordedNotAssumed: An uncertain outcome is not retried on another provider unless the caller declares the task idempotent, because the provider may already have done the work. Default is NOT_IDEMPOTENT.

A rejected credential is terminal: a fallback would keep working while the primary credential stayed broken, and trying identities until one is accepted is forbidden behaviour here. Revisitable in one place.
An unrecognised failure class is terminal, because failing over on a failure nobody understands turns one broken call into a bill on every provider.

knownSuiteIsolationFinding.test: tests/omnia-v9-gmail-effect-adapter-dispatch-recovery.test.mjs -- 'two concurrent recovery workers on the same stuck Gmail-bound execution converge on exactly one outcome'
knownSuiteIsolationFinding.observed: 177/178 once, while test:deterministic, test:browser and test:postgres-real were deliberately pointed at one shared long-lived PostgreSQL.
knownSuiteIsolationFinding.isolatedResult: 178/178 when the suite runs alone. The identical contention on unmodified main also passed 178/178.
knownSuiteIsolationFinding.rootCause: Cross-test interference in a shared table. Three test files call recoverUnresolvedExecutions against omnia_v9_external_effect_executions with limits of 1000, 500 and 50, and node --test runs files in parallel, so a sweep from another file can claim this test's row before either of its own two workers reach it.
knownSuiteIsolationFinding.whyNotABothClaimedDefect: claimUnresolvedForRecovery uses FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED inside a transaction, so two concurrent workers cannot receive the same row. The 'both claimed' branch is excluded by PostgreSQL semantics, which leaves 'neither' as the only way the assertion can fail.
knownSuiteIsolationFinding.notCausedByThisShift: No module changed in this shift appears anywhere in that test's 12-module import graph.
knownSuiteIsolationFinding.notFixed: The test was left alone rather than weakened. The real fix is test-level isolation -- the disposable per-run database the suite's own comments already name as its convention -- not a filter added to production recovery code to suit tests.
knownSuiteIsolationFinding.reproduce: Run test:deterministic, test:browser and test:postgres-real concurrently against one OMNIA_V9_TEST_DATABASE_URL.
